senses.meaning: Đại loại như, kiểu như (mang tính trang trọng hơn 'like')
examples: We need a solution along the lines of what we discussed last week.
She suggested something along the lines of a profit-sharing scheme.
The new policy will be along the lines of the European model.

senses.meaning: Ngay sau khi; theo sau (nhấn mạnh hệ quả để lại)
examples: The government tightened security in the wake of the attacks.
Several banks collapsed in the wake of the financial crisis.
New policies were introduced in the wake of the scandal.

note: Gốc: 'wake' là vệt nước sau tàu. Luôn chỉ hệ quả của một sự kiện lớn.

senses.meaning: Có rủi ro cao, liên quan đến nhiều thứ quan trọng (tiền bạc, uy tín, kết quả)
examples: The merger negotiation was a high-stakes game for both companies.
He performs well under high-stakes pressure.
This is a high-stakes decision that could define his political career.

senses.meaning: Bằng cái giá của, tốn phí/hi sinh điều gì đó
examples: He achieved success at the expense of his health.
The project moved quickly, but at the expense of quality.
She pursued her career at the expense of her personal relationships.

senses.meaning: Trên bờ vực của; sắp xảy ra, gần đến điểm tới hạn
examples: The company was on the verge of bankruptcy when the deal was struck.
She was on the verge of tears throughout the ceremony.
Scientists say the species is on the verge of extinction.

senses.meaning: Nhìn lại, khi xem xét lại quá khứ
examples: In retrospect, it was a terrible decision to take that risk.
In retrospect, I should have listened to her advice earlier.
The investment seemed risky at the time, but in retrospect it was wise.

note: Thường đứng đầu câu. Tương tự 'with hindsight' — nhìn lại mọi thứ có vẻ rõ ràng hơn.

senses.meaning: Gây tổn hại dần dần đến (sức khỏe, tâm lý, nguồn lực)
examples: Years of hard work had taken a toll on his health.
The long commute is taking a toll on her mental well-being.
The pandemic has taken a heavy toll on the tourism industry.

senses.meaning: Thay thế cho, thay vì (formal)
examples: Employees were given extra holiday in lieu of overtime pay.
The client sent a gift voucher in lieu of a cash refund.
She accepted shares in lieu of her bonus.

note: Gốc tiếng Pháp. Formal — dùng phổ biến trong văn bản hành chính và pháp lý.

senses.meaning: Chấp nhận (một thực tế khó khăn hoặc đau đớn); hòa giải với thực tế
examples: She is slowly coming to terms with the loss of her father.
It took him years to come to terms with his disability.
He has finally come to terms with the fact that he didn't get the job.

senses.meaning: Đặt nghi vấn về, làm mờ đi sự tin tưởng vào điều gì
examples: The new evidence cast doubt on the suspect's alibi.
His statement cast serious doubt on the reliability of the report.
The failed experiment cast doubt on the entire research methodology.

senses.meaning: Đi đôi với nhau, cùng tồn tại và liên quan chặt chẽ
examples: Economic growth and job creation tend to go hand in hand.
Education and opportunity should always go hand in hand.
Success and hard work go hand in hand — there are no shortcuts.

senses.meaning: Chịu đựng phần nặng nề nhất, hứng chịu hậu quả mạnh nhất
examples: The coastal towns bore the brunt of the hurricane.
Young workers bore the brunt of the layoffs.
It was the middle class that bore the brunt of the tax increases.

senses.meaning: Con dao hai lưỡi — thứ gì đó có cả lợi lẫn hại
examples: Social media is a double-edged sword — it connects people but also spreads misinformation.
Fame is a double-edged sword: it opens doors but destroys privacy.
The drug is effective but is a double-edged sword due to its side effects.

senses.meaning: Phần nổi của tảng băng chìm — chỉ là bề mặt của vấn đề lớn hơn nhiều
examples: The complaints we received are just the tip of the iceberg.
What we know about corruption there is only the tip of the iceberg.
The financial losses reported are likely just the tip of the iceberg.
synonyms: the visible part of a larger problem

senses.meaning: Chọn cái ít tệ hơn trong hai lựa chọn đều không tốt
examples: Voting for that candidate felt like choosing the lesser of two evils.
Taking the longer route was the lesser of two evils given the roadworks.
Neither option was ideal, but the pay cut was the lesser of two evils.
synonyms: the better of two bad options

senses.meaning: Giả vờ không thấy, làm ngơ (dù biết rõ điều gì đó sai)
examples: The manager turned a blind eye to the employee's dishonesty.
Authorities have long turned a blind eye to corruption in that sector.
We can't keep turning a blind eye to climate change.

note: Gốc: truyện về Nelson giả vờ không thấy lệnh rút lui.

senses.meaning: Ở tình thế nguy hiểm hoặc tế nhị, có nguy cơ gây rắc rối lớn
examples: He's on thin ice with his boss after missing three deadlines.
The politician was walking on thin ice with her controversial remarks.
Be careful — you're on thin ice making promises you can't keep.

senses.meaning: Làm ẩu, bỏ qua các bước cần thiết để tiết kiệm thời gian hoặc tiền bạc
examples: The contractor cut corners on safety measures to finish faster.
You can't cut corners when it comes to food safety.
The cheap renovations showed they had clearly cut corners throughout.

note: Thường hàm ý tiêu cực — hi sinh chất lượng hoặc an toàn.

senses.meaning: Không bị chú ý, không bị phát hiện; hoạt động kín đáo
examples: The startup operated under the radar for two years before launching.
His rise to power went largely under the radar of the media.
She prefers to stay under the radar and avoid publicity.

note: Ẩn dụ từ radar quân sự — bay thấp để tránh bị phát hiện.

senses.meaning: Tạo bầu không khí ban đầu hoặc định hướng chung cho điều gì đó
examples: The CEO's opening speech set the tone for the entire conference.
Her punctuality and professionalism set the tone for the whole team.
The gloomy weather set the tone for the day's events.

senses.meaning: Kìm hãm, giữ (thứ gì đó nguy hiểm) không cho tiến lại
examples: Antibiotics can help keep infections at bay.
The army struggled to keep the enemy forces at bay.
She uses humor to keep her anxiety at bay.

senses.meaning: Một cách lạnh lùng, tàn nhẫn và có chủ ý (thường với hành vi bạo lực)
examples: The victims were shot in cold blood in their own home.
He was convicted of murdering his business partner in cold blood.
The soldiers executed the prisoners in cold blood.

note: Thường đi với 'murder/kill in cold blood'. 'In hot blood' (nghĩa đối) = trong cơn tức giận bột phát.

senses.meaning: Điều bình thường, chuyện thường gặp, không có gì đáng ngạc nhiên
examples: Delays on this project are par for the course.
Getting stuck in traffic is par for the course in this city.
Being criticised by the press is par for the course if you're a politician.

note: Gốc từ golf: 'par' là số gậy tiêu chuẩn cho một lỗ.

senses.meaning: Bắt nguồn từ, xuất phát từ (nguyên nhân gốc rễ)
examples: His anger stemmed from years of feeling ignored.
Many health problems stem from poor diet and lack of exercise.
The conflict stemmed from a misunderstanding between the two departments.

senses.meaning: Tăng mạnh, khuếch đại (âm lượng, tốc độ, mức độ); khởi động (máy móc)
examples: They cranked up the volume as the concert began.
The factory cranked up production to meet the holiday demand.
The government cranked up pressure on the company to comply.

senses.meaning: Sự ra đời, sự xuất hiện của (điều gì đó mới, quan trọng)
examples: The advent of the internet changed communication forever.
Life before the advent of smartphones feels hard to imagine now.
The advent of electric vehicles is reshaping the automotive industry.

note: Formal. Thường dùng cho những cột mốc lịch sử quan trọng.

senses.meaning: Trở nên hỗn loạn, mất kiểm soát; (máy móc) hoạt động sai
examples: Everything went haywire when the main server crashed.
My plans went completely haywire when the flight was cancelled.
The printer went haywire and started printing blank pages.

senses.meaning: Tăng dần từng bước nhỏ (không giảm trở lại được); leo thang
examples: Tensions between the two countries have been ratcheting up for months.
The company has ratcheted up its marketing spending each quarter.
Protesters ratcheted up pressure on the government to act.

note: Ẩn dụ từ cơ cấu ratchet — chỉ tiến, không lùi.

senses.meaning: Giải quyết, sắp xếp ổn thỏa; hiểu rõ/làm rõ
examples: I need to sort out the billing issue before the end of the month.
Let me sort this out and get back to you by tomorrow.
They finally sorted out their differences and signed the contract.

note: Rất phổ biến trong tiếng Anh thông thường (informal-medium). 'Sort someone out' = trị cho xong.

senses.meaning: Loại trừ, bác bỏ khả năng của điều gì đó
examples: Doctors ruled out a serious injury after the scan.
The police have not ruled out the possibility of arson.
We can't rule out further price increases later in the year.

senses.meaning: Bãi bỏ (luật/quyết định pháp lý); hạ gục, đánh ngã
examples: The Supreme Court struck down the controversial immigration law.
The regulation was struck down as unconstitutional.
He was struck down by a mysterious illness at the peak of his career.

note: 'Strike down a law' = tòa án bãi bỏ một đạo luật. Cũng dùng nghĩa đen: bệnh/tai nạn hạ gục ai.

senses.meaning: Sự phản đối, lý do phản đối điều gì đó
examples: She raised several objections to the proposed changes.
Does anyone have any objections before we proceed?
His main objection was that the plan was too expensive.

note: 'Objection!' cũng là lời phản đối trong phiên tòa (luật pháp). 'Object to something' = phản đối điều gì.

senses.meaning: Mối tình lãng mạn (đặc biệt là bí mật hoặc ngắn ngủi); sự say mê mãnh liệt với điều gì
examples: He had a brief love affair with a colleague that ended badly.
France has a long love affair with cycling.
Her love affair with literature began when she was just eight years old.

note: Hai nghĩa: (1) quan hệ tình cảm; (2) nghĩa bóng: sự đam mê.

senses.meaning: Người hay quên, thiếu tập trung, đầu óc lộn xộn
examples: He's such a scatterbrain — he forgot his keys three times this week.
Don't trust her with details; she's always been a bit of a scatterbrain.
I know I'm a scatterbrain, which is why I write everything down.

note: Informal/lighthearted. Không mang nghĩa xúc phạm nặng — thường dùng thân thiện.
